WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_excess AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill,
         avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER () AS excess1
  FROM per_order
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill, excess1
  FROM first_excess
  WHERE excess1 > 0
), second_excess AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill, excess1,
         avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER () AS excess2
  FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT avg_fill, excess1, excess2
  FROM second_excess
  WHERE excess2 > 0
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_final_order_fill,
       AVG(excess1) AS avg_first_excess,
       AVG(excess2) AS avg_second_excess
FROM final_kept;

assumptions.assumption: Executions with NULL or zero fillcount are excluded before calculating each group's average; groups with no remaining positive or nonzero quantity are omitted. All NULL ordersmark values form one group, as SQL GROUP BY naturally does.
